tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the bufo.world catalog of bufo frog designs by words (moods, snacks, jobs, sayings, or what the picture shows) and/or a collection. Returns designs whose name matches in storefront order (most-ordered first, then A-Z), then designs whose description matches, each with its slug, emoji shortcod

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one design: every format family in brief (name, price range, option values, package and every variant id), full variants for one family (variant id, options, USD and CAD price, shipping package group, image, product page URL; stickers unless you pass family), a ready add-to-cart link, th

tools.name: download_image
tools.description: The free PNG of one or more designs: a direct download link to the full-resolution art with a transparent background (about 1,500 px), plus the emoji shortcode, a one-sentence description of the picture and a smaller preview image. Pass embed_previews to also receive the previews as images in this r

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The themed collections (e.g. work, snacks, feelings) with ids, names, design counts and cover images. Pass an id to search_products as collection to list its designs.

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Price a cart exactly as the bufo.world cart and Stripe Checkout will: line prices, merchandise subtotal, shipping per package group (each group ships separately; some US sticker packages ship free from US$20) and the total before tax. Unknown or invalid items are listed in rejected with the reason.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Build a bufo.world link that fills the shopper's cart with these items when they open it in their browser; they review it and pay on Stripe Checkout. Returns the link, its quote and any rejected items. Creates no order and charges nothing; give the link to the shopper.

tools.name: checkout_with_link
tools.description: For an agent that has the shopper's Link wallet connected (Stripe's Link CLI or Link MCP server): everything needed to buy a cart for them through Stripe's hosted agentic checkout. Returns bufo.world's Stripe business id, the catalog item id of every line, the quote, and the Link commands to create
